notes: Assemblers now work only for network orders: put them on Network Cable and the Network Crafter's orders load them, pick the recipe and collect the results. Pipes no longer feed them or take from them, and the recipe grid tab and recipe picker are gone. Anything an old Assembler still holds goes into network storage once it is on a powered network (or take it out of its screen). Also in this build (4.50.0): the Network Terminal shows each item's network total in its tooltip.
